nodes.label: App Favicon (Vite bolt mark)
nodes.rationale: Serves as the browser-tab mark referenced by frontend/index.html, but the geometry is byte-for-byte the Vite lightning-bolt logo path (purple #863bff / #7e14ff blurred-ellipse glow stack) with the Vite parenthesis glyphs removed. It encodes no spa/salon/reservation brand symbol - it is unrebranded Vite template artwork still shipping as the product's identity.

nodes.label: Browser Tab / Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: The product concept the favicon is supposed to serve. Currently unfulfilled - the tab mark is the framework's logo, so the spa reservation app has no distinct visual identity at the browser-tab level. Flagged as a rebranding gap.
